text:
alex: reported issue: importing @redwood/sdk@1.3.7 in edge env fails: "Cannot use import statement outside a module". stack shows ./node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.mjs missing sourcemap.

faye: i inspected npm pack. package.json exports.import -> ./dist/index.cjs and dist/index.mjs not in tarball. looks like publish step strips .mjs and .map

alex: ok plan: unpublish 1.3.7 if possible, cut 1.3.8; fix exports.import -> ./dist/index.mjs; add dist/*.mjs and dist/*.map to files array; add a CI pack-check that npm pack && tar -tf checks for .mjs .cjs .d.ts .map

build-bot: [release-check] pack validation failed for v1.3.7: missing dist/index.mjs, dist/index.mjs.map

faye: also add small smoke test in release matrix that does `node -e "import('@redwood/sdk').then(m=>console.log('ok'))"` so edge-like import failure is caught

alex: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/440 with fixes and pack-check. will republish after CI green. apologizing in changelog.
